notes: RNA-seq arm of a ribosome profiling study: total RNA was MNase-digested and 15-45 nt fragments PAGE-purified -> assay_class other (size-selected fragments, not total_rnaseq). Two sub-designs: pClpPX samples in LB + arabinose (inducer true, degron = knockdown), pTrm5 samples in MOPS complete synthetic + glucose (Trm5 repressed, inducer false; trmD_KO = deletion). OD 0.1-0.3 -> mid_exponential inferred. Shaking not described.
